abstract: Axum 0.8 and tower-http 0.7 rules for AI agents writing or porting HTTP services in Rust, read from the aphrody-labs forks (axum 2449f160, tower-http 8569ec8b, tower df06d70d). 13 rules across 8 categories, each with an incorrect and a correct example and the source file it was checked against. Used by the Shenron TypeScript to Rust migration (crates/shenron-api).
